formula_audit.state_boundary: Take the native one-view D update and native one-view E update first. At the resulting post-D/E state, draw two fresh conditionally iid G/F views and average their pre-Adam gradients before one G/F optimizer step.
formula_audit.estimator: g_hat_GF(theta,S) = (g_GF(theta,S;xi_1) + g_GF(theta,S;xi_2))/2, with xi_1 and xi_2 conditionally iid given the post-D/E state S.
formula_audit.conditional_covariance: Cov[g_hat_GF | S] = Cov[g_GF(theta,S;xi) | S]/2 under the preregistered conditional-iid assumption.
formula_audit.compute_only_signal_risk: The G/F portion uses two views, so any final gain must be reported jointly with wall-clock and compute cost; the mathematical claim is variance reduction at fixed optimizer update, not equal-FLOP superiority.
